name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context and previous statements in the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to maintain or increase the interest of the conversation, encouraging further dialogue.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates how logically and fluidly the response connects to the preceding statements, contributing to a smooth conversation flow.

name: Creativity
description: Rates the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in introducing new ideas or facts that enhance the conversation.

name: Contextual Awareness
description: Measures the contestant's understanding of the conversation context and their ability to incorporate relevant facts or experiences into their response.
